scene mothersmilk1
: A long time ago, when grass still covered these lands and the walls were not yet built, there was a spirit.
lines.zh: : 很久很久以前，当这片土地还长满青草、城墙尚未筑起的时候，有一个灵体。

lines.en: : It could become the things it wanted, yet wanted nothing. And in wanting nothing, it found something to want.
lines.zh: : 它能变成自己想要的一切，却什么都不想要。而正是在什么都不想要的时候，它找到了想要的东西。

lines.en: : It wanted to want something.
lines.zh: : 它想要的是「想要」本身。

lines.en: : You are the same. That is why you have found me here today.
lines.zh: : 你也一样。所以你今天才会在这里找到我。

lines.en: : That is why you remember things with no discernible link to the present — things that you could not possibly remember as you were never there {i}to{/i} remember them.
lines.zh: : 所以你会记起那些与当下毫无明显关联的事——那些你绝不可能记得的事，因为你从未在场，无从记起。

lines.en: : These chips of paint that have fallen so far from their hastily decorated ceiling have granted you images of a past that you will never uncover.
lines.zh: : 这些从仓促涂抹过的天花板上剥落、一路飘到此地的油漆碎片，赐给了你一段你永远无法亲自揭开的过往影像。

lines.en: : Put them in your mouth. Savor the moments where the lead still had flavor.
lines.zh: : 把它们放进嘴里吧。细细品味那些铅还有味道的时刻。

lines.en: : It tasted nothing like it does today.
lines.zh: : 那味道和今天截然不同。

lines.en: : Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？

lines.en: scene iamyou
scene ayhh15
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh8
scene mothersmilk2
: I am fear given physical form that changes based on the angle you observe me from.
lines.zh: : 我是被赋予了形体的恐惧，形状随你观察我的角度而改变。

lines.en: : I can be anything I want, yet there is nothing I want to be. And in wanting nothing, I am everything.
lines.zh: : 我可以成为任何我想成为的东西，却没有一样是我想成为的。而正因什么都不想成为，我便是一切。

lines.en: : The xoanon — the one who holds the strings yet neglects to tighten them.
lines.zh: : Xoanon——提线在手，却疏于把线收紧的那一位。

lines.en: : Right now, you are no more than a mere thread dangling off a fraying rope, yet it was I who allowed things to progress to this point, which means it is I who must consume your burden.
lines.zh: : 此刻，你不过是一根悬在磨损绳索上的细线；然而是我放任一切走到了这一步，也就是说，必须由我来吞下你的重负。

lines.en: : I am you, yet I am not. And this is the one thing that will never change despite any efforts you may make to ensure the opposite.
lines.zh: : 我是你，又不是你。而这是唯一一件事——无论你如何努力想让它走向反面，都永远不会改变。

lines.en: : Some threads cannot come untangled.
lines.zh: : 有些线，是解不开的。

lines.en: : Some puppets unravel when their noose is untied.
lines.zh: : 有些傀儡，绞索一解，便自行散架。

lines.en: : I don’t see myself.
lines.zh: : 我看不见我自己。

lines.en: : Do you think that is a coincidence?
lines.zh: : 你以为那是巧合？

lines.en: : Do you believe your physical presence is what establishes the connection between your mind and the outer world?
lines.zh: : 你以为，是你的肉身存在，在你的心智与外部世界之间建立了联系？

lines.en: : If so, you are foolish.
lines.zh: : 如果是，那你很愚蠢。

lines.en: : Everything is already connected.
lines.zh: : 万物早已相连。

lines.en: : These lines reach as far as the eye can see, connecting all things to all things while lying in wait for more things to connect to.
lines.zh: : 这些线一直延伸到目光所能触及的尽头，把一切与一切相连，同时静静潜伏，等待更多可供连接的东西出现。

lines.en: : You are no protagonist.
lines.zh: : 你不是什么主角。

lines.en: : You’re not even a piece of the puzzle.
lines.zh: : 你连拼图的一块都算不上。

lines.en: : You have never {i}been{/i} a piece of the puzzle.
lines.zh: : 你从来都{i}不是{/i}拼图的一块。

lines.en: : Who is it that the gods worship? And who does {i}that{/i} entity worship? At what point will true omnipotence arrive? And what will you perceive it as once it does?
lines.zh: : 众神所崇拜的，又是谁？而{i}那个{/i}存在，又崇拜着谁？真正的全能究竟何时才会降临？等它降临，你又会把它看成什么？

lines.en: : Something so bright would only blind you — which is why you live with your eyes closed.
lines.zh: : 那样耀眼的东西只会刺瞎你的眼睛——所以你才一直闭着眼活着。

lines.en: : You are no more than a walking gravestone, decorated with the deaths of all you have encountered — but there is no one who would ever waste the time necessary to tread upon your grave.
lines.zh: : 你不过是一块会走路的墓碑，上面刻满了你所遇见的一切人的死亡——可没有谁会愿意浪费时间，去踏上你的坟头。

lines.en: : This is where you will come when you die.
lines.zh: : 你死之后，会来的就是这里。

lines.en: : This is what Heaven looks like.
lines.zh: : 这就是天堂的模样。

lines.en: scene mothersmilk3
: Heaven is real?
lines.zh: : 天堂是真的？

lines.en: : {i}Everything{/i} is real.
lines.zh: : {i}一切{/i}都是真的。

lines.en: : Yet the ethereal-you clings to hope that this is all some sort of dream you will one day awaken from.
lines.zh: : 然而那个缥缈的你，仍执着地盼着这一切只是某种终有一天会醒来的梦。

lines.en: : There can be no coincidences when the human idea of free will is writing one’s own script when it is something more powerful than you scripting your scriptwriting in the first place.
lines.zh: : 当人类所谓的自由意志不过是自己在写剧本，而写你这出「写剧本」这件事的，本就是比你更强大的存在——那就不会有巧合可言。

lines.en: : To break free of the pattern and disrupt the cycle is impossible.
lines.zh: : 想挣脱这个模式、打乱这个循环，是不可能的。

lines.en: : Nothing you do will ever amount to anything.
lines.zh: : 你所做的一切，都不会有任何意义。

lines.en: : Why do you still play this game?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还要继续玩这个游戏？

lines.en: : I need to...learn.
lines.zh: : 我需要……学习。

lines.en: : The thirst for knowledge has led countless others to an untimely demise.
lines.zh: : 对知识的渴求，已将无数人引向了过早的死亡。

lines.en: : What is it you wish to learn?
lines.zh: : 你想学什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know...I don’t even understand where I am right now. I was at my apartment just a few minutes ago and...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我甚至不明白自己现在在哪儿。几分钟前我还在我的公寓里，然后……

lines.en: scene mothersmilk4
: And now you’re not...
lines.zh: : 而现在你不在那儿了……

lines.en: : Because you were not meant to be there.
lines.zh: : 因为你本就不该在那儿。

lines.en: : You were meant to be here.
lines.zh: : 你本就该在这里。

lines.en: : But there is nothing I can do for you that your own reflection can not.
lines.zh: : 但我能为你做的，你自己的倒影同样做得到。

lines.en: : The all seeing eye only sees as far as the eye can see.
lines.zh: : 全视之眼，也只能看到眼睛能看到的地方。

lines.en: scene ayhh15
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh8
scene mothersmilk5
: The rest comes from instinct and a talent for bending time like molten glass.
lines.zh: : 剩下的，靠的是本能，以及一种把时间像熔融玻璃一样弯折的天赋。

lines.en: : There are secrets inside of me. I store them in my guts and thank them every day for the way they make my stomach sing.
lines.zh: : 我体内藏着秘密。我把它们存放在肚肠之中，每天都感谢它们让我的胃唱起歌来。

lines.en: : But you are undeserving...
lines.zh: : 但你配不上……

lines.en: : And your place here, though necessary, is unwanted.
lines.zh: : 而你在此的位置，虽属必要，却并不受欢迎。

lines.en: : Here as in...where?
lines.zh: : 这里是指……哪儿？

lines.en: : Heaven?
lines.zh: : 天堂？

lines.en: : Here as in a vast collection of universes known only as the Wishing Well — where all information created by man is chronicled and protected by those who created him.
lines.zh: : 这里，是一片只被称为「许愿井」的浩瀚宇宙集合——人类所创造的一切信息都在此被记录，并由创造他的那些存在守护着。

lines.en: : I don’t understand...why would you do something like that?
lines.zh: : 我不明白……你们为什么要做这种事？

lines.en: : Why do humans collect ants and place them in tiny glass boxes?
lines.zh: : 人类为什么要把蚂蚁收集起来，放进小小的玻璃盒里？

lines.en: : Because they {i}can.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为他们{i}做得到{/i}。

lines.en: : And because it’s interesting. Wouldn’t you agree?
lines.zh: : 而且因为有趣。你不同意吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I guess? Sure, just...I’m having a hard time getting a handle on what’s happening right now. It feels like I’m supposed to be dreaming, but...
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧？好吧，只是……我现在很难搞清到底在发生什么。感觉我应该是在做梦才对，可是……

lines.en: : This doesn’t seem like a dream to me.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说不像梦。

lines.en: : The fact that you’re able to speak and think at all is something you should be proud of. Most consciousnesses are ripped apart once they make it to the library.
lines.zh: : 你能开口说话、能思考这件事本身，就该让你感到骄傲。大多数意识一到图书馆，就被撕碎了。

lines.en: : The library?...Is that the name of this place?
lines.zh: : 图书馆？……这地方叫这个名字？

lines.en: : Does it look familiar? Do you want to call it something else?
lines.zh: : 看着眼熟吗？你想给它换个名字？

lines.en: : No, I...I need to go.
lines.zh: : 不，我……我得走了。

lines.en: : The reset’s probably happening right now and I have to make it to the rooftop or else-
lines.zh: : 重置大概正在进行，我必须赶到天台，不然——

lines.en: scene ayhh15
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh8
scene mothersmilk6
: Or else what?
lines.zh: : 不然怎样？

lines.en: : You’re afraid you’ll be left behind? That the {i}others{/i} will be left behind?
lines.zh: : 你怕自己被落下？还是怕{i}其他人{/i}被落下？

lines.en: : Do your connections with different ants really mean enough to you that you’d walk away when there is still sand to be excavated?
lines.zh: : 你和不同蚂蚁之间的那些羁绊，真的重要到让你在还有沙子没挖完的时候就转身离开吗？

lines.en: : Your job is not to live and learn to love- it’s to crawl around in circles...in desperate hope of one day escaping, only to shrivel up and die and have your offspring carry you away.
lines.zh: : 你的职责不是活着、不是学会去爱——而是绕着圈爬行……绝望地盼着有朝一日逃出去，最后却干瘪而死，由你的后代把你抬走。

lines.en: : Pretending you’re anything more than that is silly. And believing any of it will change if you find out who you are and where you come from is even sillier.
lines.zh: : 假装自己不止于此，是愚蠢的。而以为一旦弄清你是谁、来自哪里，这一切就会随之改变——那就更愚蠢了。

lines.en: : Let me go...
lines.zh: : 放我走……

lines.en: scene mothersmilk7
: Silence, puppet.
lines.zh: : 安静，傀儡。

lines.en: : You will dance until your legs give out.
lines.zh: : 你会一直跳，直到双腿撑不住为止。

lines.en: : The ropes are nowhere near decayed just yet and will remain that way for quite some time.
lines.zh: : 那些绳索还远未腐朽，而且在相当长的一段时间里都会保持原样。

lines.en: : There are still some who wish to use you. And while I may not be one of them, I do not think they are wrong for doing so.
lines.zh: : 仍有人想利用你。虽然我不是其中之一，但我并不觉得他们这样做有什么错。

lines.en: : Will you still struggle even knowing it is hopeless?
lines.zh: : 明知无望，你还要挣扎吗？

lines.en: : Will you still attempt to see through the lines in your misshapen eyes?
lines.zh: : 你还要用那双畸形的眼睛，试图看穿那些线吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
scene ayhh15
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh8
scene mothersmilk8
: Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Then, I’ll continue to look forward to the tunnels you will build.
lines.zh: : 那么，我会继续期待你将挖出的那些隧道。

lines.en: : But I’ll warn you now that the story you’ve been reading thus far has been nothing more than a precursor to the pain yet to come.
lines.zh: : 但我现在就警告你：你迄今为止所读到的故事，不过是即将到来的痛苦的前奏。

lines.en: : You will see such beautiful things...{i}feel{/i} such wondrous moments...{i}convince{/i} yourself that there is a point to all of it.
lines.zh: : 你会看见如此美丽的事物……{i}感受{/i}如此奇妙的瞬间……然后{i}说服{/i}自己，这一切都是有意义的。

lines.en: : But there won’t be.
lines.zh: : 但不会有的。

lines.en: : I would have seen it if there was.
lines.zh: : 如果有，我早就看见了。

lines.en: : You will suffer and it will be for nothing.
lines.zh: : 你会受苦，而那将毫无意义。

lines.en: : Do you still want to go home?
lines.zh: : 你还想回家吗？

lines.en: : I do! Get me out of this nightmare!
lines.zh: : 想！把我从这个噩梦里弄出去！

lines.en: : I’m afraid I can’t do that without first giving you a tour of my bowels.
lines.zh: : 恐怕不行——在那之前，我得先带你在我的肚肠里游览一圈。

lines.en: scene ayhh15
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh8
scene mothersmilk9
: I am the cataloger of what you’ve felt and what you’ll feel.
lines.zh: : 我是编目者，记录你曾感受过的、以及你将感受到的一切。

lines.en: : I am the one who dissects the impact your “actions” will have on the immediate story — then decides whether or not adjustments should be made and informs the ones concerned.
lines.zh: : 我负责剖析你的「行为」会对眼前的故事产生何种影响——然后决定是否该做出调整，并知会相关者。

lines.en: : I have watched it all.
lines.zh: : 这一切我都看在眼里。

lines.en: : I have gotten drunk off of your pain and reveled in your joy in those few fleeting moments where it occurred.
lines.zh: : 我沉醉于你的痛苦，也在那些稍纵即逝的欢愉时刻里，纵情享受你的喜悦。

lines.en: : You may call me a guardian angel if you like, but I prefer the name “Nao.”
lines.zh: : 你愿意的话，可以叫我守护天使，但我更喜欢「Nao」这个名字。

lines.en: : You’re no guardian. A guardian {i}protects{/i} people from pain — they don’t just sit there and watch.
lines.zh: : 你算什么守护者。守护者是{i}保护{/i}人不遭痛苦的——而不是坐在一旁看着。

lines.en: : They do when they know it all serves a greater purpose.
lines.zh: : 当他们知道这一切都服务于更宏大的目的时，他们就会这么做。

lines.en: : We all have a role to play. We’re all cogs in a much bigger machine. You needn’t be jealous because I’m a bigger, shinier cog than you.
lines.zh: : 我们各有角色要扮演。我们都只是一台更大的机器上的齿轮。你不必嫉妒，只因为我是比你更大、更亮的一颗齿轮。

lines.en: scene mothersmilk10
: Just think of all we’ve been through together!
lines.zh: : 想想我们一起经历过的一切吧！

lines.en: : Every thing that you’ve felt, I’ve felt as well! And those sensations are not limited to me and me alone!
lines.zh: : 你所感受过的一切，我也都感受过！而这些感受，并不只属于我一个人！

lines.en: : Each fellatio, ejaculation, penetration, defloration — they’ve all flowed through me.
lines.zh: : 每一次口交、每一次射精、每一次插入、每一次破处——它们都曾流经我。

lines.en: : You’ve copulated with {i}me{/i} more times than anyone. You should be happy you’ve gotten to spend so much time with an entity so much bigger than you and lived to tell the tale.
lines.zh: : 你与{i}我{/i}交合的次数，比任何人都多。你该高兴才对——能和一个远比你庞大的存在相处这么久，还活着把这段故事讲出来。

lines.en: : Even if that tale {i}is{/i} mere moments away from expiring and you soon won’t be able to {i}tell{/i} anyone.
lines.zh: : 哪怕这个故事再过片刻就要终结，你也很快就再没机会{i}讲给{/i}任何人听了。

lines.en: : Good...because I don’t want to remember any of this. I just want to go home.
lines.zh: : 很好……因为我一点都不想记住这些。我只想回家。

lines.en: scene mothersmilk11
: How come you don’t want to remember me? Do you think it would be a little too painful?
lines.zh: : 为什么你不想记住我？觉得那样会太痛苦吗？

lines.en: : No...I just feel like if I’m ever going to remember anything {i}important,{/i} I need to do it on my own.
lines.zh: : 不是……我只是觉得，如果我真要记起什么{i}重要{/i}的事，得靠我自己。

lines.en: : Having someone pop up out of thin air just to show me a slideshow of things I’ve already experienced doesn’t do much for me. It doesn’t get me anywhere.
lines.zh: : 有人凭空冒出来，只为了给我放一遍我已经经历过的事的幻灯片，这对我没什么用。它不会让我有任何进展。

lines.en: : You don’t know that yet. The “slideshow” is just beginning.
lines.zh: : 这你可还说不准。那场「幻灯片」才刚刚开始。

lines.en: : The library is an endless font of wonderful memories — and the only way you’ll ever get to re-experience things like this!
lines.zh: : 这座图书馆是美好回忆的无尽源泉——也是你唯一能重新体验这一切的方式！

lines.en: scene ayhh15
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh8
scene mothersmilk12
: {i}Mmnch...mmmf....hmn!{/i}
: {i}Mngh...mm...what...are you doing?! Someone...mmf...might see us!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……唔……你在……干什么？！会……唔……会被人看见的！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t...mmngh...help it!...I can’t hold back any longer...I just love you so much!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我……嗯……忍不住！……我再忍不住了……我就是太爱你了！{/i}

lines.en: : Someone {i}did{/i} see you — a middle aged man in the house just across the street from where the two of you decided to do {i}this{/i} for five minutes.
lines.zh: : {i}确实{/i}有人看见了——街对面那栋房子里，一个中年男人看着你们俩就{i}这么干{/i}了五分钟。

lines.en: : Four years later, he would be arrested on several counts of possession of child pornography.
lines.zh: : 四年后，他会因数项持有儿童色情制品的罪名被捕。

lines.en: : He never stopped pleasuring himself to this beautiful memory.
lines.zh: : 他靠着这段美丽的记忆自慰，从未停过。

lines.en: scene ayhh15
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh8
scene mothersmilk13
: There’s also this one — when you weren’t feeling well and had to stay home from school.
lines.zh: : 还有这一段——你身体不舒服，不得不请假待在家里的那次。

lines.en: : Your brother’s wife jumped at the opportunity to {i}care{/i} for you and, well I think we can both see why.
lines.zh: : 你哥哥的妻子立刻抓住机会来{i}照顾{/i}你，至于原因嘛……我想你我都心知肚明。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...hah!...Ngah!{/i}
: {i}Shh...breathing that heavily is just going to make you even {i}more{/i} sick. You’re supposed to be resting, Akira. You should know better.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘘……喘得这么厉害只会让你病得更重。你该好好休息才对，Akira。你该懂事的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can’t...help it when...you’re doing things like that!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我……忍不住啊……你做那种事的时候！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Like what? Say it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}像什么？说出来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ngh...n...no! It’s...mm! Embarrassing!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……不……不要！这……唔！太丢人了！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What’s there to be embarrassed about? What we’re doing is totally natural and always makes me feel better when I’ve got a fever.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有什么好丢人的？我们做的事再自然不过了，而且我发烧的时候这么做，总会让我舒服些。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Now go on, say it. Say what I’m doing to you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}来吧，说啊。说我在对你做什么。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re...ngh.......hah! I can’t do it!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你在……嗯…………哈！我说不出口！{/i}
